LanguageData.Cultist.EndingReveal.Returned: On the far side, every scratch in the brass has a name. You fix one detail in your memory, then turn back. In the colony, your assistant is still holding the lamp.
LanguageData.Cultist.EndingReveal.Departed: Your shadow stops at the sill. Beyond it, someone asks for your name. You give it, and hear the latch fall behind you. The lamp at the altar goes out.
